GpsFallback.Name: GPS item with Play Animation off falls back
GpsFallback.Hint: When Play Animation is unticked on a Gambit's Premades item, let BLFX animate it, or Automated Animations if BLFX has nothing. When off, that item stays silent.

AaCustomWins.Name: Customized AA item beats BLFX auto-rec
AaCustomWins.Hint: An item with its own customized Automated Animations config keeps it instead of using BLFX auto-recognition. A hand-made BLFX animation on the item still wins.

Debug.Name: Debug log
Debug.Hint: Write to the browser console which engine took each item use.

BLFX_AA_BRIDGE.LookupFailed: BLFX-AA Bridge could not read BLFX's animation lookup. Automated Animations will play alongside BLFX until the bridge is updated. See the console for details.
